name: @haven_ai/connect
description: Haven connect — one command wires an AI agent to budgeted, non-custodial payments: installs the MCP runtime and generates the agent signing key locally, registering only the public address.

scripts.build: npm --prefix ../mcp run build && npm --prefix ../signer run build && tsup && node ../../scripts/verify-connect-bundle.mjs
scripts.test: npm --prefix ../mcp run build && npm --prefix ../signer run build && vitest run
scripts.smoke:pack: npm --prefix ../sdk run build && npm run build && HAVEN_CONNECT_PACKAGE_SMOKE=1 vitest run src/package-smoke.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix ../mcp run build && npm --prefix ../signer run build && tsc --noEmit
